protocol.test_rule: Never consumed by this study; no selection, automatic promotion or extra test evaluation

equal.normalization: sum of all achievement rewards equals achievement count

difficulty.normalization: sum of all achievement rewards equals achievement count

protocol.analysis: Final 16M paired training-seed contrasts. Report descriptive 95% paired-t intervals and Bonferroni 98.75% intervals for four primary score contrasts. Five seeds are small; no checkpoint pseudoreplication. Rates and curves are secondary/descriptive. V4/v7 is a bundled environment contrast, not an isolated direct-selection effect.
protocol.scope: Fresh initialized spatial PPO only; fixed C gameplay, original observations/legal masks, unweighted evaluation, no expert data, prerequisite shaping, strategic masks, novelty, recipe controller, API spending, cluster or PufferLib migration. Difficulty weighting is an explicit subjective sparse training-objective intervention.
